open.title: The recruiting pitch
open.body: One choice shapes the class that signs in two days. A class matters for four years: the roster is the last four classes.

options.label: Sign a safe class
options.detail: The class the programme has earned, no better and no worse.

options.label: Chase a star
options.detail: 38 in 100 that the star signs and the class is 10 points better. Otherwise the class is 5 points worse.

open.title: Drinks at the tailgate?
open.body: The boosters ask whether fans of 21 and over may drink at the tailgate before the next home game. Campus Safety has views. So does the Medical Center.

options.label: Keep the tailgate dry
options.detail: Nothing changes. Grills, tents and a great deal of lemonade.

options.label: Allow drinks for fans of 21 and over, with ID checks: $46,000
options.detail: Ten in a hundred more fans want a ticket for three days. Calls from parties come twice as often for those three days.

open.title: A film crew wants the quad
open.body: A film about a much older, much grander university needs a quad for two days. Yours will do, they say, with some ivy brought in.

options.label: Rent out the quad: $460,000 comes in
options.detail: Happiness is 1.5 points lower for two days: the quad is closed, and nobody gets to be in the film.

open.title: The clubs ask for the main quad
open.body: A new semester, and forty clubs want the main quad for a fair. Thirty-nine have filled in the form. The juggling club has sent a diagram.

options.label: Give them the quad: $46,000 for tables
options.detail: Happiness is 1 point higher for three days.

open.title: A college guide wants to profile the campus
open.body: Happiness is 83, which is the kind of number a college guide likes to print. The writer needs a room, a tour and, the guide is clear about this, lunch.

options.label: Host the writer: $276,000
options.detail: Four in a hundred more applicants for seven days, which takes in the next class.

memory.text: Kit Wrenley is your main character: a freshman in Biology, a Scholar. Their goals: make the dean’s list and graduate on time.
Today's plan for Kit Wrenley: friends (a quiet day).
